title: From your measurements to your door
description: Measure once, choose your outfit, and a tailor makes it for you. Buying ready to wear? Just pick your size.

steps.title: Measure
steps.description: Measure yourself with your phone in about a minute, no tape needed. Already have your numbers from a tailor? Type them in.

steps.title: Choose
steps.description: Pick an outfit from a tailor’s store, or design your own and let tailors send you a price.

steps.title: Made and delivered
steps.description: Your tailor makes it to your measurements and sends it to you. Follow it all the way to your door.
